title: Perspective file
description: A perspective saved as YAML in the repository (SR-213, D-056): a list of elements with a name, its selection, its grouping and its sort, as a `*.yaml` file directly in the `perspectives` folder of the workspace file. A perspective stores no view: the app lists it in the view of its window, the other accesses in `selection.view` (SR-213). Element references may take any form; `perspective.save` writes UUIDs.

description.description: What the perspective is for, for people.

filter.description: Name of a saved filter (SR-070) that the selection also uses, read again on each call (SR-213 AK6).

where.description: The conditions of the selection, in the language of a saved filter. A selection with no condition is `{ all: [] }`.

group.description: The grouping of the list (SR-149). Absent: not grouped.

name.description: Name of a perspective, unique among the perspectives of the workspace ignoring case and Unicode normal form; a saved filter may have the same name. Saving under an existing name replaces that perspective (SR-213 AK3).
